description: Create invite codes. Requires admin or moderator role. With `count`, creates that many independent codes with the same settings (one per person to invite).

main.description: Generate a new invite code with optional usage limits and expiration.

maxUses.description: Maximum number of times the invite code can be used. Defaults to 1.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration timestamp for the invite code.

boundTo.description: Optional email address the code is bound to; only that address can register with it.

note.description: Optional free-text note kept with the code, visible to admins in invite.list.

count.description: How many codes to create, each with these settings. Defaults to 1.

maxUses.description: Maximum number of uses for this invite code.

expiresAt.description: Expiration timestamp, or null if the code does not expire.

boundTo.description: The email address the code is bound to, when one was given.

note.description: The note, when one was given.

codes.description: Every code created, in order; `code` is the first. Present when `count` was given.
